description: This file defines the AdvancedPaymentAllocationsValidator class responsible for validating advanced payment allocation rules within the loan product domain of the Apache Fineract project. It includes validation methods for strategy compliance, rule ordering, duplication, grouping, and allocation types.

classes.name: AdvancedPaymentAllocationsValidator
classes.description: Service class providing validation logic for advanced payment allocation strategies and rules related to loan products.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a list of loan product payment allocation rules against the specified strategy code, ensuring compliance with default rules and no duplicate transaction types.

methods.name: validatePairOfOrderAndPaymentAllocationType
methods.description: Ensures that the order list contains exactly 12 entries with unique values from 1 to 12 and no duplicate payment allocation types.

methods.name: checkGroupingOfAllocationRules
methods.description: Validates that the grouping of allocation rules is consistent, checking for conflicts in due types.

methods.name: validateAllocationType
methods.description: Validates an individual payment allocation type within a rule, considering its due type.

methods.name: validateDueType
methods.description: Ensures that due type rules do not conflict with each other, throwing validation errors for invalid combinations.

methods.name: hasDuplicateTransactionTypes
methods.description: Checks whether the list of rules contains duplicate transaction types.

methods.name: validateAllocationRule
methods.description: Validates individual allocation rules for presence of valid transaction and installment allocation types.

methods.name: isAdvancedPaymentStrategy
methods.description: Determines whether the provided code matches the advanced payment allocation strategy.

methods.name: hasAtLeastOneDefaultPaymentAllocation
methods.description: Checks if at least one default transaction type is present among the rules.

methods.name: hasLoanProductPaymentAllocationRule
methods.description: Checks if the rules list contains any rules.

methods.name: raiseValidationError
methods.description: Throws a data validation exception with the specified error message.
